battery_description: Conservative 68 x 36 x 10 mm packaging envelope; supplied photo identifies 68 x 35 x 10 mm wrapped pack and 66 mm lead. The 36 mm width is a design allowance, not a measured battery dimension.
hardware_and_routing: Battery and wire/plug geometry are illustrative packaging envelopes, not manufacturer mating-plug CAD. Pair colors do not establish real connector pin orientation. Simultaneous USB-overmould/battery-plug fit remains unqualified.
overview_notes: The original 2.4 mm floor separates the pouch from PCB solder joints and header pins. OLED and PTT geometry retain R3 positions.
Four M3 x 6 screws and four M3 inserts sit outside the pouch footprint. Use about 1 mm nonconductive padding and two soft 10 mm straps without rigid pouch compression.
A local rear hood accommodates the provisional harness route. A matched extension may be needed for service access.
Battery connects to Heltec BAT only. The carrier amplifier still requires USB. Battery-only operation needs verified speaker-disabled firmware.
Pack tolerance, plug keying/polarity, charging limits and simultaneous USB-cable fit require hardware checks. No complete battery operating qualification is claimed.
connection_note: Verify actual keyed plug fit and end-to-end polarity before connection. Existing firmware drives AMP_SD HIGH at startup; battery-only use requires a verified mode holding it LOW while the USB-powered amplifier is unpowered. Confirm the pack permits Heltec's approximately 500 mA charging. The assumed battery plug overlaps the generic USB-overmould reservation; actual simultaneous connector fit remains unqualified.
source_note: Sources: Meshnology battery product page; Heltec V4.3.1 datasheet pp12-14 and V4.3 schematic JP2; Analog Devices MAX98357A datasheet p4. Full URLs and reviewed constraints are in research/BATTERY-CONNECTION-REVIEW.txt. Battery body and lead dimensions come from the supplied photo.
